subject: BENCHMITTENS
name: Mittens — fine sepia lines and luminous ginger washes

styleSelection.reason: Dry placed value planes preserve the light portrait sketch; focal ink carries sub-wash-width lids and whiskers while hair and tabby markings remain transparent paint.

families.referenceCue: Two upward-looking pale olive eyes: narrow dark upper lids, elongated pupils, tiny white catchlights. Dry focal paint; fitted linework.
Tall pointed ears and ginger forehead bars separated by white fur; pale warm base, dry shaped ochre and sienna planes.
White muzzle, brown nose and mouth junction; slight warm-grey chin shade and long fine whiskers. Keep broad paper white.
Connected warm ginger cheek planes with irregular white stripe gaps; dry shaped planes and a shared shadow glaze down the right neck.
White bib and pale shoulder; lost paper edges, sparse ochre along left outer shoulder.
Ginger right neck continues cheek, medium ochre and sienna with directional white gaps; deepest narrow contact shadow against the person.
Charcoal brown-grey curly hair framing the pale forehead; connected mixed-dark paint masses, reserved paper curls; no ink fill or stippling.
Dark brows and fine upper lids above light eye sockets; keep eye whites lightly tinted and the fitted pupil glints.
Pale warm skin with nose, nostrils and smile seam; connected side shadow into jaw, slight dry-edge stubble implied by wash; no hatching.
